<!--
One field sets the margins in every format with pages: margin, in typst's
shape. typst reads it itself; formatlatex.lua turns it into geometry options
for the .pdf, written after the mode's page; docxreferencedoc.lua writes it
into the .docx's reference document. The .pdf used to read only geometry,
and .docx had no margin option at all.

x sets the left and right and top the top; the bottom is not named and keeps
the mode's inch. 2cm is 0.787402in.
-->
